parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Asia-Pacific tours, can I help you?

Yes, I've been looking at your website and I'd like some more information about your activity holidays.

Certainly. You know of course the prices of the tours include stays in three star hotels and they include airfares.

Great. What about your tour of Vietnam? My sister went there last year and loved it.

Yes, it's a really beautiful place and probably our fastest growing destination. Now that package includes several opportunities to take courses.

Don't you have a cookery course of some kind?

We certainly do. If you love eating out in Vietnam like most people do and want to know how to prepare a meal you can learn how from a master in a five star hotel. On another day you have a choice of two activities. The first is instruction in diving in the South China Sea. Not a certificate course but just an introduction. Most people think it's wonderful. Or if you want to stay dry but still want some exercise, you can spend the day on a trek through the jungle near the beach. It's not difficult and everyone seems to enjoy it.

Anything cultural on offer?

We used to take people to a Vietnamese opera but that didn't prove so popular. So now we include a dance show and our clients all rave about that. They say the colours are just magnificent.

What's the cost?

I've just noticed it's now a special price. The holiday used to be £1,600 but it's just been reduced to £1,450 so you do save quite a bit. And as I said, it seems to be our up and coming tour.

Well, let's see. Perhaps you could tell me a little about the Hong Kong tour. I noticed it includes a walk in the hills of one of their country parks, where you have the chance to see birds of all sorts.

Yes, that's a very popular activity. People don't realise that Hong Kong isn't just a crowded city. That's a half day activity and you go with a trained escort. And it includes dinner in a monastery where you end your day.

And then we wouldn't want you to miss out all together on shopping. So there's another day when we take you round an electronics factory. Now, that might sound like an odd thing to do but it's actually really fascinating and not like your usual ceramics factory. And you can buy their products there quite cheaply. Now the whole Hong Kong package is just £1,320 per person.

Sounds interesting. But let me find out about one more place. I've always wanted to go to Korea but not on this trip. And I've been to Thailand which I loved. But what about your Japan package?

Good choice. Well, that tour includes a terrific trip to a museum of traditional costume. The exhibits are gorgeous. They've got an absolutely priceless collection.

And I think the website says you take your clients to a market, don't you? A crafts market, I think?

Well, we do go to a market but it's one that sells fish and it's one of the largest in the world. And you have the chance to sample the wares in a little restaurant nearby. We also give you plenty of free time to wander around the city with our guides if you want.

And what's the cost of all that?

£1,800.

Wow, you've been ever so helpful. I've noted all the details down and I'll get back to you when I've made up my mind.

If we can give you any more help, do ring back.

Thanks, I will.

analyses.content: 关于越南游的活动选择，第一个就是关于在南中国海进行 diving（潜水） 的指导课程。
Agent: The first is instruction in diving in the South China Sea.
题目是 "either _____ lessons or..."，对应原文的 "The first is instruction in diving..."，Instruction 即 lessons 的同义替换。
Agent: ...you can spend the day on a trek through the jungle near the beach.
题目是 "trek in the _____"，对应原文 "trek through the jungle"，介词 in/through 替换，核心名词 jungle 不变。
如果不选潜水，另一个选择是在海滩附近的 jungle（丛林） 里徒步一天。
Agent: So now we include a dance show and our clients all rave about that.
"Opera" 是干扰项（used to take... but that didn't prove so popular），现在的项目是 dance show。
现在越南游包含了一场 dance（舞蹈） 表演，客户们都赞不绝口。
Agent: The holiday used to be £1,600 but it's just been reduced to £1,450...
典型的“价格调整”考点，£1,600 是过去的价格（used to be），现在的价格是 £1,450。
越南游现在的特价是 £1,450。
Customer: ...where you have the chance to see birds of all sorts.
题目是 "look at _____"，对应原文 "see birds of all sorts"，所听即所得。
在香港的行程中，去郊野公园的山里走走，有机会看到各种各样的 birds（鸟类）。
在香港的半日游活动结束后，包含在修道院（monastery）里的一顿 dinner（晚餐）。
Customer: And it includes dinner in a monastery where you end your day.
题目是 "followed by _____ in a monastery"，原文结构是 "includes dinner in a monastery where you end your day"，逻辑一致。
Customer: So there's another day when we take you round an electronics factory.
"Ceramics" 是干扰项（not like your usual ceramics factory），正确答案是 electronics。
香港行程还包括参观一家 electronics（电子产品） 工厂，这比普通的陶瓷工厂更有趣。
Customer: But what about your Japan package?
这是一道简单的地点排除题，Korea 和 Thailand 都是顾客不想去或去过的地方。
顾客排除了韩国（Korea）和泰国（Thailand），最后询问的是 Japan（日本） 的套餐。
Agent: Well, that tour includes a terrific trip to a museum of traditional costume.
题目是 "museum of traditional _____"，对应原文 "museum of traditional costume"。
日本游包含参观一个传统 costume（服装/服饰） 博物馆。
Agent: Well, we do go to a market but it's one that sells fish...
"Crafts market" 是顾客的猜测（干扰项），中介明确回答是 "sells fish"，填名词修饰 market。
关于市场，中介纠正说那不是手工艺品市场，而是世界上最大的 fish（鱼/海鲜） 市场之一。
